extraction.Name: Katie Peck Young
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent in fee but took it under protest. on the advise of the District Farmer and the Superintendent, some time after she had received the notice
extraction.Recorded patent: she did not have it recorded but that her husband did some time after she received it
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: sold her land to Art Stevens of Wanblee, So. Dak. to pay a large doctor bill and the taxes that she could not pay
extraction.Buyer: Art Stevens of Wanblee, So. Dak. at $22.00 per acre
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: sold to pay a large doctor bill and the taxes that she could not pay
extraction.Occupation/Income: a little sewing when she can get it
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent and in very poor health, doctoring all the time; has received no help from the Government, State or County since she received her patent; widow with two children to support; has no home; document dated 1928
